title: Refactor: extract a helper without breaking tests
prompt: The file `stats.js` has one function `summary(nums)` that computes mean, min and max in a single tangled block. Refactor it: extract three small named helpers `mean(nums)`, `min(nums)`, `max(nums)` and also EXPORT them (alongside `summary`), with `summary` delegating to them. The existing public behaviour of `summary` must not change. The test file `verify.test.js` is present and must keep passing via `node --test verify.test.js`. Do NOT modify the test file.
